slide1.title: Experience Fine Dining
slide1.description: Reserve your table effortlessly and enjoy unforgettable moments.

slide2.title: Taste Luxury Cuisine
slide2.description: Every dish is crafted with passion and premium ingredients.

slide3.title: Reserve Your Table
slide3.description: Create memorable moments with your loved ones.

dish1.title: Charred Steak & Golden Fries
dish1.description: Perfectly grilled premium beef glazed with our signature burgundy sauce, served with crispy golden fries and a rich creamy pepper sauce for an unforgettable dining experience.

dish2.title: Smoky Grilled Chicken Skewers
dish2.description: Juicy marinated chicken skewers flame grilled to perfection with roasted peppers and herbs, served with our signature smoky dipping sauce.

dish3.title: Creamy Garlic Seafood Pasta
dish3.description: Tender shrimp tossed with silky fettuccine in a rich garlic cream sauce, finished with fresh herbs for a smooth and satisfying flavor. Every bite delivers a perfect balance of creamy richness and delicate seafood freshness.

dish4.title: Herb Grilled Salmon
dish4.description: Fresh Atlantic salmon, perfectly grilled with aromatic herbs and served with roasted baby potatoes, seasonal vegetables, and a touch of charred lemon for a light yet flavorful experience.

description.first: Savora was born from one simple belief: every great meal should tell a story. Inspired by authentic flavors and refined culinary techniques, we create dishes that combine premium ingredients with timeless recipes.
description.second: From the first spark on the grill to the final garnish, every plate is prepared with passion, precision, and genuine hospitality. Our goal is not only to serve exceptional food, but to create memorable moments for every guest.

quote.text: "We don't just cook food, we build the moment around it."
quote.author: Head Chef, Savora

WhyChooseUs.title: Why Choose Savora
WhyChooseUs.subtitle: Everything you need for a perfect dining experience.

reservation.title: Reserve in Seconds
reservation.description: Book your table in seconds with a fast and seamless reservation process. Choose your preferred date and time, receive instant confirmation, and enjoy a stress-free dining experience from the very beginning.

table.title: Choose Your Perfect Spot
table.description: Find the table that perfectly matches your preferences before you arrive. Whether you're planning a family gathering, a romantic dinner, or a casual meal with friends, you can browse available tables, compare seating areas, and reserve the exact spot that best fits your occasion and comfort.

experience.title: Enjoy a Premium Experience
experience.description: From the moment you reserve your table to the moment you're comfortably seated, our platform is designed to make every step simple, smooth, and enjoyable. Experience a smarter way to dine with flexible reservations, personalized seating choices, and a service that puts your convenience first.

Footer.description: Reserve your table in just a few clicks. Enjoy a seamless dining experience with easy online reservations.
